messages:
incident-bot: [P1] REDWOOD-DEDICATED autoscaler alert: scale_up stalled in azure-ukwest (GPU quota hit). Queue length on inference-router-ukw has grown from 50 -> 420 in the last 6m. Error: "QuotaExceeded: Requested cores/gpu beyond subscription limit". Dash: https://console.redwood/insights/alerts/1993456789 :rotating_light:
raj_oncall: Acknowledged. Observed customer 99th latency spike? Emma / SRE can you confirm impact? Paging now.
emma_ops: I see a big backlog on route `dedicated-infer-ukw`. 420 pending, rate 120 r/s, token backlog increasing. Errors returned to clients are 429/503 depending on internal queue overflow. Not yet widespread but a number of paid tenants ondedicated-ukw are impacted.
devin_sre: Confirming. Autoscaler requests to Azure are returning 403/QuotaExceeded for new VMSS GPU allocations. Current nodepool: sku=Standard_ND40rs_v2, desired +8 failed. Azure quotas show GPUs at limit for subscription-sub-ukw.
miguel_eng: Is there a fallback policy? We have small-quantized model variant (gpt-small-q4) that can run on CPU but higher latency. Could route low-priority requests there.
raj_oncall: Action list — 1) route low-priority/async jobs to cpu-fallback queue 2) enable cross-region spill to eu-north for critical tenants 3) open escalation with Azure for quota bump 4) manual temporary downscale of batch size to reduce memory pressure. Assign owners?
emma_ops: Taking 1 & 2 now. Pushing routing rule change: 
```yaml
# traffic-split override for incident
routes:
  dedicated-infer-ukw:
    low_priority: cpu-fallback-ukw
    critical: forwarded-eunorth
```
Applying via infra-runbooks deploy-router-config.
cloud-ops: Opening Azure support ticket: #AZ-78910 (priority: Standard -> escalated). Sent quota request for +64 GPUs in UK West. ETA based on prior requests ~2-6 hours. Adding ticket link: https://portal.azure.com/#support/subscriptions/az/requests/AZ-78910
devin_sre: While we wait, I can patch the autoscaler to tolerate 0 available GPUs and drop to CPU fallback for pods that are not latency-critical. Command: 
```
kubectl patch hpa inference-autoscaler -n dedicated --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'
```
I'm also lowering batch_size from 16 -> 8 to reduce per-request memory to reduce queue head-of-line blocking.
miguel_eng: I'll flip the routing but expect spike in eu-north. Please monitor cost/latency. Also enabling a temporary model-quantization override on the router: `model_override: gpt-medium-q4` for leisure tiers.
amy_cs: Notifying affected customers: 3 dedicated tenants in UKW flagged. Posting to status page: "We are experiencing degraded performance for Dedicated UK West; mitigation in progress."
raj_oncall: Good. I will start the handoff timer. Next oncall will be devin_sre in 30m. Devin — I will include runbook pointer and current mitigations in the handoff note.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: handoff scheduled to devin_sre at +30m. Current incident priority: P1. Links: runbook://dedicated-autoscale-quota and dashboard://dedicated/ukw/queue.
devin_sre: Got it. Joining. Quick summary for next: autoscaler hitting Azure GPU quota; routing split applied to route low-priority to CPU fallback and critical to eu-north; Azure support ticket AZ-78910 created; manual HPA patch & batch size lowered. Monitoring for successful pod launches and queue drain.
cloud-ops: Azure responded: preliminary approval for +32 GPUs while they audit (AZ-78910). They requested justification and billing contact. I've attached the cost center and initiated expedited review.
emma_ops: Queue dropping: 420 -> 210 over 12 minutes after routing changes. Error rate 503 -> 15% then 7%. Critical tenants now mostly routed to eu-north, one still pending due to sticky sessions — working to evict sticky cookie.
miguel_eng: Note — CPU fallback increases 99th latency from ~300ms -> ~1.8s. Logging that on status page so customers know.
amy_cs: Posted update to customers + status page: "We have applied temporary routing and fallback; some requests may see higher latency. Working with Azure to restore GPU capacity."
raj_oncall: If Azure approves +32 quickly we should scale back routing and restore normal performance. If not, we'll keep spillover and schedule a mid-incident postmortem. For now I'm initiating an incident channel doc: /incidents/1993456789 with timeline. Handoff to devin_sre in 15m.
devin_sre: Acknowledged handoff. Will monitor and coordinate with cloud-ops for quota completion, and with eng for rollback once GPUs available. If any tenant reports major data-impact escalate to sec/compliance.
incident-bot: Update: Azure ticket AZ-78910 status changed -> `EscalationAccepted`. ETA still 1-4 hours. Keep monitoring.
emma_ops: Final note before stepping away: routing/timeboxed mitigations in place; backlog reduced but not cleared. Leaving console session & playbook with devin. @devin_sre you have context + runbook link.
raj_oncall: Thanks team. Handoff complete. @devin_sre you're oncall owner. I'll be available if needed. :handshake:
